summary: Iteration 7: All new features tested successfully. Backend: 17/18 tests passed (1 false positive due to old data without prazo field). Frontend: All UI elements verified via Playwright. Features tested: A) Estudo de Mercado - Prazo field with A vista/Safra/Safrinha options, Valor (R$/L) and Dose (L/ha) labels. B) Planejamento - 'Meus Relatórios' button, Investimento labels (replaced Custo). C) Password reset flow - 'Esqueci minha senha' link, forgot-password and reset-password APIs. D) Admin user-activity - aggregated data with Total de Acessos, Dias Ativos, Último Acesso columns.

minor.issue: Old market studies created before prazo field was added don't have the prazo field in response. This is expected behavior - not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 5989 lines - consider splitting into smaller components for maintainability
Estudo de Mercado form correctly implements Prazo select with 3 options (lines 5341-5352)
Planejamento summary uses 'Investimento' labels instead of 'Custo' (lines 4702, 4709, 4717)
'Meus Relatórios' button correctly implemented with data-testid='saved-reports-btn' (line 4090)
Password reset flow correctly implemented with forgot-password page (lines 3398-3555)
Admin user-activity endpoint returns aggregated data per user (backend lines 1211-1250)
Admin UI shows aggregated columns: Total de Acessos, Dias Ativos, Último Acesso (lines 5850-5863)
seed_data_creation: Created test market studies with prazo field (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 tested new features: 1) Estudo de Mercado has Prazo field (data-testid='market-prazo-select') with options A vista/Safra/Safrinha. 2) Labels are 'Valor (R$/L)' (data-testid='market-valor-input') and 'Dose (L/ha)' (data-testid='market-dose-input'). 3) Planejamento has 'Meus Relatórios' button (data-testid='saved-reports-btn') and uses 'Investimento' labels instead of 'Custo'. 4) Password reset: 'Esqueci minha senha' link on login page leads to forgot-password page with data-testid='reset-email-input' and 'reset-send-code-btn'. 5) Admin 'Uso da Plataforma' tab shows aggregated user activity with Total de Acessos, Dias Ativos, Último Acesso columns.
